brief: A vector that lives on the GPU, so that kernels can be chained on it with no transfer until it is downloaded once.
detail: Obtain one from stzGpu.UploadQ, chain single-input kernels with ApplyQ, read the result with Download, and call Free when done. The object holds two numbers, the generation-keyed engine id and the element count, so a copy shares the same device buffer and a stale id after Free or eviction is reported as stale and never answers with another buffer's data. Every method except init, Id_, Count and IsAlive needs the GPU, which sleeps on this machine, so they were read from the code and not run.
